push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 10.0 (best match performance)
push.body:
Mercy me, PhogsToffees. A 10.0. That one goes in the scrapbook, page one.

THE GOOD
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 1). You threaded the needle and stitched up a chance.
+ A goal against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Right place, right time, right foot.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. The game noticed, and so did I.
+ You and tuxedo_slide were finishing each other's sentences out there.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 7.5. Small wins add up to big ones.

THE BAD
- Pass accuracy: 80%. Good, not great yet; top-quarter forwards sit at 88%+.
- Shots: 1. Raise it to 3+ and you're a difference maker.

Pre-match routine: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.

One thought for the road, PhogsToffees: Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

Bring that energy back next match. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.6 (5th best match performance)
push.body:
Your 5th best match performance, BellyTb1. An 8.6. That's the stuff.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ 1 assist. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ You & tuxedo_slide clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ That 8.6 sits as your 5th best match performance. Lovely stuff.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (2). More of that, please and thank you.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. One more thing: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. Feet first, then flair.
- Heads up, you and tuxedo_slide: defensive work rate. Simple fix: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- On-ball actions 9, down from your usual 22. Let's not make that a pattern.

Drill of the day: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: Win the next five seconds, then the next five.

Champions are made on nights like this. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.5 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.5. That ranks as your 2nd best match performance. Proud of you, partner.

THE GOOD
+ 14 passes (down from your usual 16). You were in the middle of everything, like gravy on mashed potatoes.
+ A brace against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway.
+ An 8.5 ranks as your 2nd best match performance. That's who you are on a good day.
+ Part of a 4-0 beating of unbeatables FC. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.
+ Their humans averaged 6.7 to our 9.0; we out-played them man for man. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Next match: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs. Steady does it.
- 57% passing (8 of 14). Homework: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Biscuits if you nail it.
- No key passes from 14 passes. Low-hanging fruit: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass. Trust me on that one.
- defensive work rate needs work from you and BellyTb1. Easy plan: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.5 (best was PhogsToffees's 10.0). That's the stone in your boot. Take it out.

Coach's drill: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

tuxedo_slide, one more thing before you log off: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

I'm framing this one. - Coach Lasso
